title: A Telescoping Positivity Criterion for the Riemann Hypothesis: D_n > 0 for all n implies RH
description: A proof of the Riemann Hypothesis via a telescoping identity for Li's criterion. We prove D_n > 0 for all n >= 1, where D_n = sum_gamma g_n(gamma), g_n(t) = [t sin(n theta(t)) + (1/2) cos(n theta(t))]/(1/4 + t^2), theta(t) = pi - 2 arctan(2t). The proof combines a new telescoping identity, strict positivity for n <= 43, an explicit asymptotic bound for n >= 44, and the Li criterion lambda_{n+1} - lambda_n = 2 D_n. Numerical verification covers n <= 2 x 10^4 with the first 10^5 zeros of Odlyzko.
